description: Dated waivers of scripts/quality/check-embedded-tools-advisories.py. One entry per finding that is accepted until a date: component (identifier of embedded-tools.json), finding (advisory identifier, or end-of-support), reason, expires (YYYY-MM-DD). An expired entry, a malformed one, or one that no longer matches a finding fails the watch. See docs/developer/supply-chain.md.
